Frequently asked questions

What are the monthly payment dates in Saudi Arabia?

Government salaries on the 27th, the Citizen's Account on the 10th, developed social security on the 1st and Hafiz on the 5th, all Gregorian. GOSI pensions are commonly cited on the 25th and SANED around the 5th, both estimates GOSI has not published.

Do dates move when they fall on a Saturday?

Salaries and the Citizen's Account move from Saturday to Sunday and from Friday to Thursday. For social security the ministry announces another date, and HRDF states no rule for Hafiz.
